name: wagie-tools

scripts.lint: biome check src test scripts migrations package.json tsconfig.json biome.json
scripts.format: biome check --write src test scripts migrations package.json tsconfig.json biome.json
scripts.schema:generate: bumbledb-log snapshot --schema src/schema.ts --export ledger --out migrations/0000-initial/schema.json && bumbledb-log bindings --snapshot migrations/0000-initial/schema.json --out migrations/0000-initial/schema.ts
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm schema:check

description: Local payroll and bookkeeping for a single-owner S corporation.
